messages:
Jordan (content): Hey team — putting together the launch drip for the Q2 feature roll (low-latency routing). Want quick feedback on cadence + segmentation before I lock copy.
Ava (growth): High level — two streams: 1) existing trial users (get them to upgrade to Dedicated) 2) prospects who downloaded benchmark pdf (educate then demo). Different CTAs.
Sam (ops): Agree. For trial users: day 0 onboarding email, day 3 tips + cost-savings examples, day 7 invite to 1:1 demo or office hours.
Jordan (content): Draft subject lines: "Get predictable LLM inference costs — see how", "Reduce token spend by 3x with smart batching", "Invite: live demo — production-ready inference" — thoughts?
Taylor (sales): For prospects from benchmark download, lead with benchmark highlights. Subject: "Benchmark: same quality, 40% lower per-token cost" — that hooks enterprise folks.
Priya (analytics): Segmentation rules proposal (SQL):
```
WHERE event = 'downloaded_benchmark'
AND company_size > 50
AND region IN ('US', 'EU')
```
Also suppress anyone who converted in last 30 days.
Ava (growth): Also split by intent score > 60 for SDR routing. If score > 80 assign to Taylor, else nurture.
Sam (ops): Routing automation: add tag `sdr_route:yes` in HubSpot for >80. Can we add UTM + campaign params: utm_source=newsletter_q2&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch?
Jordan (content): Personalization tokens: {{company_name}}, {{trial_days_left}} for trial stream. Keep plain text option for fallback.
Taylor (sales): Quick ask — include short playbook for SDRs in the outbound: "top objection = cost" + two rebuttals. I can draft.
Priya (analytics): A/B test plan: subject A = cost-savings angle, subject B = reliability/latency. Sample size 5k, measure OR and demo clicks over 7 days.
Ava (growth): Cadence for benchmark prospects: day 0 deliver PDF + 1-click demo CTA, day 4 case study, day 10 webinar invite. Webinar on day 14.
Jordan (content): Webinar email copy done in rough. Need speaker blurbs and one-liner on what attendees will learn.
Sam (ops): Operational checklist: suppression list, unsubscribe handling, frequency cap (max 3 emails / 30 days), tracking pixels added.
Ava (growth): Can someone confirm the nurture drip suppresses current customers? Last time a staging list accidentally included them.
Priya (analytics): Confirmed — we have a filter on account_type != 'customer'. Will add a second pass check before send.
Taylor (sales): Routing details: when a demo click happens, HubSpot task assigned to rep within 5 minutes. If no rep available, queue to on-call SDR.
Jordan (content): Action items: I’ll finalize copy + subject lines by EOD tomorrow. Ava — you set up A/B test in HubSpot? Priya — can you validate segment SQL and suppression?
Ava (growth): On it. Will create test and share preview links.
Priya (analytics): I’ll run a dry-run on Monday with a 200-person seed list and report edge cases.
Sam (ops): I’ll schedule the sends, but will not activate until we get a thumbs up from Sales and Analytics.
LaunchBot: Campaign "q2-benchmark-launch" created (draft). Preview emails sent to team.
Jordan (content): Nice. @Taylor if you can drop the SDR play deck by tomorrow noon that helps.
Taylor (sales): Yup — will post the playbook link here when done. :thumbsup:
Ava (growth): One more: include a short micro-survey in the day 7 email for trial users (1-click feedback). Helps quality signals.
Jordan (content): Great — wrapping this up. Will post final thread with all copy + subject lines + preview links.
